newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PORT PILOTS STAGE TWO-DAY STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PORT PILOTS STAGE TWO-DAY STRIKE.

text.p: Greek port pilots are on a two-day strike to press pay demands but authorities said there had been little or no effect on shipping.
The president of the pilots union, Theordoros Geranios, said the strike, which ends on Wednesday morning, was successful but acknowledged that ships were docking on there own around Greece.
"This is the only country in the world where international practices are ignored," he lamented in a telephone call with Reuters.

Port officials at Piraeus, the country's biggest port, said no ship had been stopped from leaving or entering by the strike. The merchant marine ministry also said no ship had been delayed in ports around the country.
The pilots want higher pay and are protesting over state regulations governing their pension fund. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
